verdict.rationale: A state business-filing agency could plausibly offer bulk-filer, system-account, or transmitter programs, so this axis applies. The evidence pack shows only human-facing online filing (Express Annual Report, CCFS, online registration and closure), downloadable forms, live chat, and an in-person counter. There is no documented system-to-system channel or published enrollment path for software transmitters. The DOR portal probe shows only a JavaScript app shell, which is a different agency's portal and not a machine interface.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
